title: Writing results and limitations
outcome: Explain writing results and limitations using the records and boundaries of this fictional investigation.
scenario: Write results without enlarging them. A fictional study evaluates answer support on twelve fixed questions from one approved collection.
given: A supports 9/12 answers; B supports 10/12. No user learning outcomes are recorded.

steps.label: Report the observation
steps.detail: A is 75%; B is about 83.3%, a one-case improvement.

steps.label: Link to the method
steps.detail: Name the collection, rubric and twelve-case denominator.

steps.label: State limits
steps.detail: Do not infer that children learn more from this answer-support measure.

explanation: Results describe what was measured; limitations prevent substitution of a different outcome or population. A small descriptive improvement needs its scope attached.

counterfactual.prediction: Remove that sentence as unsupported by the study.
counterfactual.reason: The measured unit was answers, not student understanding or intelligence.

student_task: Compute the supported-answer rates for 9/12 and 10/12. What actual outcome was measured, and why is a claim that every student becomes smarter outside this evidence?
teacher_answer: A is 75%; B is about 83.3%, a one-case improvement. Name the collection, rubric and twelve-case denominator. Do not infer that children learn more from this answer-support measure. Changed case: Remove that sentence as unsupported by the study. The measured unit was answers, not student understanding or intelligence.
project_evidence: For the Reproducible AI Research Study, retain an annotated worked trace and the changed-case reasoning. Connect the claim to its records, units and assumptions so another investigator can challenge or reproduce it.
limits: No significance or stable population effect is established; broader task and learner evidence would require another study.
review_note: Individually authored fictional practice distinct from the reserved independent case. No invented significance, real experiment execution or pupil outcome is asserted.
